[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 8 September 2026, when BCH traded near $255.00. BCH is $336.30 today.

[2026-09-08_BCH]  
Video Title: When to Accumulate Bitcoin Cash ($BCH) 🚨  
Video ID: VOywi2MPWUY  
Bitcoin Cash (BCH) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
• Current trading price sits at $255, just below the 20‑week SMA of roughly $268 and the 200‑week SMA of $345.  
• Composite risk score is slightly above 33, currently at 37/100, placing BCH in a neutral risk zone.  
• Social sentiment remains balanced with bullish and bearish narratives equally popular; social risk over the last 30 days is 40% and over the last 7 days is 40%.  
• The golden breakout orbit criteria—>90‑day ROI > median, risk $200 and $280; current price is near the midpoint, indicating a modest TWAP risk level.  
• Regression‑based fair‑value band places the lower bound at $200 and the upper bound near $280; BCH is currently at $255, comfortably inside the band.  
• Undervaluation residual zone exists below the 20‑week SMA; overvaluation residual zone lies above the 200‑week SMA.  
• The model flags a 4‑year target of $1,500 (~5.5× current price) and a long‑term bull target of $292,700 by 2029, reflecting a potential 7–10× upside.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
• ML (ARMA) forecast places a non‑panic drawdown floor at $165–195 and a panic floor at $107; the base case ranges from the current price to $265–270.  
• Bull case targets span $300–400, with a 4‑year upside of $1,500 and a 2029 target of $292,700.  
• Macro moving‑average supports: 20‑week SMA at $268 (current support), 200‑week SMA at $345 (resistance).  
• Cycle analysis indicates the current bear market is ~82% complete, suggesting a potential bullish phase if the price breaches the 200‑week SMA.
